title: Look Before You Leap: A Self-Review Bayesian Optimization Method for Constrained High-Dimensional Design Space Exploration
problem: Parameterizable RISC-V processor design exploration faces high model errors during Bayesian optimization and lacks effective constraint handling for practical feasibility.
motivation: RISC-V processor customization requires exploring vast design spaces while respecting synthesis constraints; existing methods neglect constraints and accumulate model errors.
method: Proposes SRBO (Self-Review Bayesian Optimization) integrating teacher-student paradigm within local Bayesian optimization to reduce model errors; uses deep ensembles for effective constraint handling.
key_novelty: Teacher-student paradigm within Bayesian optimization for reducing model errors and handling design constraints.
contributions: Teacher-student Bayesian optimization framework reducing model errors
Deep ensemble constraint handling for design feasibility
Outperforms state-of-the-art methods within limited time budgets

metrics.other: improved exploration efficiency within time constraints

baselines: state-of-the-art RISC-V design space exploration methods
limitations: Not discussed—no analysis of scalability to other processor architectures or constraint types.
primary_theme: Teacher-student Bayesian optimization for constrained processor design space exploration
